verdict.rationale: Eqvista documents its own advanced permissions that control who can view or modify sensitive equity data, plus custom roles and a secure data room. These suggest authorized outside parties could get limited, non-admin access to equity data. Nothing shows delegated programmatic access for vendors like HRIS systems or wealth managers, or how fine-grained the scoping is. Missing for 10: scoped API/OAuth-style delegated access for third-party applications, documentation of how third-party (law firm/HRIS/wealth manager) roles are scoped to data slices, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, third parties my company authorizes — law firms, HRIS vendors, wealth managers — can access scoped slices of equity data on our behalf without full admin credentials
